data.name: Motore_CieloAssente
data.value: The sky quality (SQM) is missing. Without it the engine cannot tell how much sky background you are collecting, and computes nothing at all, neither the hours nor the sub length: sky background is half of the signal-to-noise ratio. Declare it above, between *{0}* and *{1}* mag/arcsec².

data.name: Motore_CieloImplausibile
data.value: SQM *{0}* is not the brightness of an imaging site: values between *{1}* and *{2}* mag/arcsec² are expected. {2} is the natural sky with no artificial light, {1} is beyond the centre of a large city.

data.name: Motore_CieloNonValido
data.value: SQM *{0}* is not a sky brightness. It is almost always the decimal point: 20.8 typed as 208, or as 2.08.

data.name: Motore_InErrore

data.name: Motore_JsonIlleggibile
data.value: The engine could not read the request the plugin sent it. This is a plugin fault, not something you did. The engine says: {0}

data.name: Motore_NessunaPrescrizione
data.value: With the filters you declared there is no workable road for this object. Try declaring more filters in the wheel, or pick an object the lines you own can actually trace.

data.name: Motore_RichiestaIncompleta
data.value: The plugin sent a request without {0}. This is a plugin fault, not something you did.

data.name: Motore_RichiestaTroppoGrande

data.name: Motore_SetupIncompleto
data.value: The setup is incomplete: the {0} “{1}” is missing data without which nothing can be prescribed — {2}. Fill them in and try again.

data.name: Motore_SetupSconosciuto
data.value: The setup is not recognised: {0} “{1}” is not among the entries the engine knows. Pick one from the list, or describe it.

data.name: Motore_ViaSconosciuta
data.value: The plugin knocked on a door the engine does not have. This happens when plugin and engine are different versions: update whichever is older.

data.name: Opzioni_CheCosEe
data.value: Brings into N.I.N.A. the prescription decided by AstroImage-Strategy: which channels to shoot, how many exposures, what sub length and which gain mode. This bridge decides nothing — it takes a prescription already worked out and builds it in the Advanced Sequencer. It never starts anything: pressing Play is your job.

data.name: Opzioni_ChiLHaFatto
data.value: Author and maintainer: Alessandro Curci. The code was largely written by an artificial intelligence assistant (Claude, by Anthropic), under his direction and his review.

data.name: Opzioni_DoveSiComanda
data.value: Everything is driven from the “AstroImage Strategy” panel, under Imaging: that is where you ask for a prescription, declare which filters you really have in the wheel — once per profile — and deliver the target. This page only holds the language, which instead applies to every profile.

data.name: Opzioni_LinguaAiuto
data.value: Applies to the panel and to the bridge's own messages, not to N.I.N.A. It is not kept in the profile: it is the same for every site, because the person reading is the same. Out of the box the bridge speaks English.

data.name: Opzioni_ServeIlMotore
data.value: On its own this plugin does nothing: on the other side there must be AstroImage-Strategy answering on an HTTP port. Without it, the panel opens and tells you the engine is not answering.

data.name: Pag_CalcolataDiSerie
data.value: *the engine's stock filters*, not yours: declare your filters above and ask again.

data.name: Pag_ConfigFiltriNota
data.value: what the filters in your wheel physically are. Declared once per profile.

data.name: Pag_LatLonNota
data.value: Latitude and longitude come from the N.I.N.A. profile and are not written here. So does the Custom Horizon, if you have configured one: it travels whole, azimuth by azimuth, and it is what decides. The minimum altitude below is the fallback for those who have none.

data.name: Pag_ModoNota_dinamica
data.value: Shortens the sub so the stars do not saturate, starting from Balance and reducing it only where needed. More frames, but more dynamic range in the highlights.

data.name: Pag_ModoNota_equilibrio
data.value: Shortens the sub as far as it pays off: a fair trade between acquisition time and the length of the single sub.

data.name: Pag_ModoNota_resa
data.value: The longest sub the physical limits allow; less total acquisition time to reach the same depth.

data.name: Pag_NessunFiltroDichiarato

data.name: Pag_NienteAvviato
